processing_strategy: Acquire fixed EA aerial raster for the course footprint.
Preserve original ECW and catalogue metadata.
Reproject only working copies if required; retain source CRS EPSG:27700.
Register OSM geometries to the fixed public raster using measured control points.
Run feature-specific pixel mapping against the actual public raster rather than screenshots.
Use EA LiDAR DSM/FZ DSM/point cloud to identify trees and vegetation structure absent from OSM.
Use DTM to derive terrain/elevation and support lie/slope modelling.
Keep OSM, imagery-derived, and LiDAR-derived features separately attributed until verification/fusion.
Validate independent source agreement before promoting derived geometry.
do_not: Do not use user screenshots as the primary source.
Do not fabricate a registration transform.
Do not infer tree polygons from RGB alone when LiDAR structure is available.
Do not overwrite OSM source geometry with derived imagery geometry.
